content_sections.heading: KAU Skilled Assistant Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.information: Regional Agricultural Research Station, Ambalavayal, Kerala Agricultural University

content_sections.heading: About KAU
content_sections.text: The Regional Agricultural Research Station at Ambalavayal, Wayanad, is a station of Kerala Agricultural University. These posts are for the project "Development of AEU based PoP Recommendations for Major Crops of Kerala", which the station is carrying out under the KERA Project.

rows.pay: Rs. 750/- per day (maximum Rs. 20,250/- per month)

content_sections.heading: KAU Skilled Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: BSc Agri. Candidates must also be prepared to travel, because the work involves visiting the project's model farms in Wayanad district. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at the Regional Agricultural Research Station, Ambalavayal.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of appointment: daily wage basis, for a project under the KERA Project. Place of work: the project is implemented at model farms in Wayanad district, and selected candidates will visit these farms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KAU Skilled Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Collect the original documents that prove your age, educational qualification and experience. Make copies of all these documents. Report with the originals and copies at the Regional Agricultural Research Station, Ambalavayal, Wayanad - 673 593, at 10.00 am on 12 November 2026. Attend the interview, which is scheduled for 10.30 am.

faq.question: Q1. How many Skilled Assistant vacancies are there at RARS Ambalavayal?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies, all for the post of Skilled Assistant, and they are filled on a daily wage basis.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for the Skilled Assistant post?
faq.answer: The notice lists BSc Agri. as the educational qualification for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How much will a Skilled Assistant earn?
faq.answer: The wage is Rs. 750 per day, and monthly earnings cannot go above Rs. 20,250.

faq.question: Q4. What time should I reach the venue?
faq.answer: Be at the Regional Agricultural Research Station, Ambalavayal, at 10.00 am. The interview is scheduled for 10.30 am the same day.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the originals and copies of the documents proving your age, educational qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Will the job involve travel?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must be ready to travel to the project's model farms in Wayanad district.

faq.question: Q7. Which project are these posts for?
faq.answer: They are for "Development of AEU based PoP Recommendations for Major Crops of Kerala", a project under the KERA Project.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I contact about this notice?
faq.answer: The station's letterhead gives mobile number 9188224421 and phone numbers 04936 260421 and 04936 260561.
